## Our model now

A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

- **Box:** 18.7 × 7.16 m, storeyed hall
- **Heights:** platform 0.45 m, eave 5.95 m, ridge 8.63 m above the ground
- **Roof:** hip-and-gable 歇山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile
- **Faces:** 173° from north
- **Fit:** reduced towards the size drawn on the plan, to stand clear of its neighbours or the water
- **Confidence:** C

## Texts and drawings (5)

- **E0186** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 泽兰堂. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j83:12b · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_083.txt
  > 由寳相寺度城關而東迤南為翠交軒軒下石室為熙春洞北為愛山樓又北為澤蘭堂（長春園册）臣等謹案愛山樓上額曰天風海濤樓下額曰山静雲閒澤蘭堂額曰神觀蕭爽
  East of 寳相寺 through a walled gate: 翠交軒 with the stone room 熙春洞 under it, 愛山樓 and 澤蘭堂. The note gives plaques.
- **E0191** (poem, sure): 爱山楼. 乾隆二十四年 (1759) · v3 p.356, under 泽兰堂; source ref 6-706 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=359
  > 因迥为髙易，依山得阁清。所欣此朴斫，奚事彼雕甍。泐嵃窗中纳，崥崹砌下平。毎怀仁者乐，益切体元情。
  Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1759, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.
- **E0192** (poem, sure): 爱山楼. 乾隆二十五年 (1760) · v3 p.357, under 泽兰堂; source ref 7-276 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=360
  > 问谁无所爱，仁者乃爱山。斯楼得斯名，顾宁不腆颜。能仁渠足当，为仁愿勉旃。鸟语花香地，春风秋月天。皆可谓之仁，凭窗揽结间。
  Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.
- **E0193** (poem, sure): 爱山楼. 乾隆三十三年 (1768) · v3 p.359, under 泽兰堂; source ref 9-423 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=362
  > 书楼称爱山，山色罨窗间。堪味仁者寿，端欣静以闲。云常封石迳，叶未锁林关。适可纵遥目，丹梯漫重攀。
  Poem 爱山楼 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 泽兰堂.
- **E0187** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 泽兰堂. 2020 edition · v3 p.356 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382569071850.pdf#page=359
  On the south slope of the northern hill, south of 大水法; begun 1746 and known for rockwork. 萃交轩 with the grotto 熙春洞 below, 爱山楼, pavilion 环碧; 泽兰堂, a five-bay high-terrace hall, and 理性居 were added in 1759. Used as a study, and the best view over the fountains.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 爱山楼, 5x1 cells. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
